title: Formula schedule emits the transform
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-numbered variables, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{rest}$ be bit strings with $x=\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)\,\mathrm{rest}$. For every fresh cursor $j\in\mathbb{N}$, running $1+\sum_{C\in\varphi}(|C|+2)$ rounds from formula phase with cursor $j$ and consumed length $|\mathrm{pre}|$ emits the encoding of the clause-splitting transform of $\varphi$ starting at cursor $j$, and ends in finished phase with the final cursor of that transform and consumed length $|\mathrm{pre}|+|\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)|$.
hypotheses_covered: Prefix and suffix bit strings $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{rest}$ satisfying $x=\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)\,\mathrm{rest}$
replaced:
Let the input contain the serialization of a formula $\varphi$ at the consumed
position, with the seam in the formula phase at cursor $j$. Then exactly the
round count of $\varphi$ many rounds consume the serialized formula, emit exactly
the serialization of the threaded clause transform of $\varphi$ at $j$, reach the
finished phase, and leave the cursor at the transform's final value.
